name: Queer Frame
subtitle: Does she die? Is it worth it?
promotional_text: Find out whether any queer characters die before you start, and where to watch. Over 2,000 shows, works offline, no account, nothing tracked.
description:
Queer Frame is a no-account, no-tracking guide to queer TV.

Look up a show and see:
• Is it worth watching? LezWatch.TV's worth-it verdict, plus ratings for quality, realness and screen time.
• Do any queer characters die? Hidden until you tap to reveal, so you find out when you choose to.
• Tropes and content notes.
• Where to stream it.
• When the next episode airs.

Filter for shows with no recorded deaths, with a where-to-watch link, or by worth-it verdict. Favourite what you're following and see each show's next episode at a glance. Favourites stay on your iPhone.

Queer Frame bundles its data, so it works offline as soon as it's installed, and it tells you how current that data is. The data is a nightly mirror of LezWatch.TV, the volunteer-run database of queer female, non-binary and transgender characters, and of TVmaze, credited on every show and character. Where the source is silent, the app says so: "not recorded" never becomes "survives".

No account. No analytics. No ads. No third-party SDKs. The app's one network request fetches its data file.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases.
